body:
Adds `research/chirp-twin`: a sawtooth FMCW radar twin that reads true range vs the real radar's `R + κv` bias.

- Signal-level beat-tone simulation matches `R0 + κv + vT` to ≤1e-4 range cells.
- Bias is `f_D T` range cells, independent of bandwidth.
- Compensating with a wrapped Doppler is worse than doing nothing on half of the over-range speeds.
- Stationary-scene map bias and distortion in closed form, checked against numerical Procrustes.
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok (228 projects); 9 new tests pass.

Stylised and preliminary; no radar data. Builds on ARPG / Autonomous Systems IRT directions without implying affiliation.
